label: Create a video
blurb: Makes a video with sound from words alone on Veo 3.1 Fast. Runs on Comfy Router with your key.

inputs.default: Realistic phone video, vertical, static camera on a tripod. A fluffy golden retriever stands on its hind legs in the middle of a bright, sunny living room and dances happily: it sways side to side, bounces, waves its front paws and turns in a small circle. The whole dog stays fully in frame from head to tail for the entire clip, nothing passes in front of it. Plain cream walls, a wooden floor, a green plant in the corner, soft daylight from a window. Audio: an original upbeat ukulele tune with hand claps, no lyrics, paws tapping on the wooden floor, one cheerful bark near the end.
